subject: Renewal & SOW alignment: PR agency + event vendor for Q3 product launch
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Brightline PR <sarah@brightlinepr.com>, EventCraft Ops <ops@eventcraft.co>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 10 Apr 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal & SOW alignment: PR agency + event vendor for Q3 product launch

Hi Sarah and EventCraft team —

Hope you’re both well. We’re formalizing vendor plans for the Q3 product launch (target week of Aug 18). Before we lock budgets, can you each send an updated SOW/quote that: 

- Covers a condensed 6-week engagement window (two weeks pre, launch week, and three weeks post)
- Calls out travel/onsite costs separately for a single two-day on-site kickoff and one day at the event
- Shows a line for optional post-launch earned media support (for Brightline) or extra AV/bump options (for EventCraft)

Vanessa (marketing) and Laura (finance) are looped to confirm scope and budget. We’d like these by EOD Friday 4/11 so we can compare and route to Legal.

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
Head of Growth Programs
Redwood Inference

Attachments: none
From: Sarah Alvarez <sarah@brightlinepr.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 10 Apr 2025 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal & SOW alignment: PR agency + event vendor for Q3 product launch

Marissa —

Thanks for the heads up. I attached an updated SOW that maps to the 6-week timeline and separates travel and optional earned media retainer. Highlights:

- Retainer for core PR support (media outreach, briefing docs, press day) — $28,000
- One-time kickoff (onsite) — $3,500 (travel + per diem included)
- Optional earned media retainer (4 weeks post-launch) — $7,500
- Deliverables and KPIs listed on pages 2–3

We can tighten or expand any line items once you confirm final scope. Doc attached: Brightline_SOW_Q3-2025.pdf

Best,
Sarah Alvarez
Director, Client Strategy
Brightline PR

Attachment: Brightline_SOW_Q3-2025.pdf
From: EventCraft Ops <ops@eventcraft.co>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Jamie Kim <jamie@jkdesigns.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Apr 2025 13:28:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal & SOW alignment: PR agency + event vendor for Q3 product launch

Hi Marissa —

Attached is our base quote and a line-by-line for the two-day onsite and event-day AV package. Key callouts:

- Standard booth + basic AV (screen, mics, lighting) — $18,200
- Add-on: premium AV & camera crew (event recording) — $6,500
- Travel/logistics for crew (one two-day visit) — $2,100
- Early commitment discount (signed by 4/18): 7% off total

We asked Jamie (designer) to include a quick estimate for booth graphics and collateral mockups — attached as a note. File: EventCraft_quote_Apr2025.xlsx

Cheers,
EventCraft Ops

Attachment: EventCraft_quote_Apr2025.xlsx
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sarah Alvarez <sarah@brightlinepr.com>, EventCraft Ops <ops@eventcraft.co>
Date: Fri, 11 Apr 2025 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal & SOW alignment: PR agency + event vendor for Q3 product launch

Thanks for the SOWs — good first pass. A few internal notes: 

- Prefer Brightline to keep optional earned media as a separate PO (we may do a smaller pilot post-launch). Please show it as a separate invoiceable item.
- EventCraft: confirm whether booth graphics are included in the premium AV line or a separate vendor line. If separate, request Jamie to send a bounded quote (flat fee + 2 rounds of revisions).

Laura — can you confirm approx budget bands we should expect to clear (for forecasting) if we take Brightline base + EventCraft base + premium AV? I’ll aim to secure marketing budget allocation once we have a clear number.

Vanessa Ortiz
VP, Growth Marketing
Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 14 Apr 2025 10:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal & SOW alignment: PR agency + event vendor for Q3 product launch

Vanessa / Marissa —

I ran the numbers. Rough expected spend if we accept the base packages: 

- Brightline base retainer: $28,000
- EventCraft base package: $18,200
- Premium AV add-on (optional): $6,500
- Travel/onsite line items combined: ~$5,600

Total (base packages only): $46,200
Total (with premium AV): $52,700

We have room in the Marketing Q3 discretionary bucket to cover up to $50k without additional approvals. Anything above requires VP approval (Finance + Procurement). Recommend: commit to base packages now, hold premium AV pending firm event site confirmation.

Also looping Markus for a quick check on SOW language for substitution and IP clauses.

Laura Bennett
Senior Manager, Finance Ops
Redwood Inference
From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sarah Alvarez <sarah@brightlinepr.com>, EventCraft Ops <ops@eventcraft.co>, Jamie Kim <jamie@jkdesigns.com>
Date: Thu, 17 Apr 2025 14:35:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal & SOW alignment: PR agency + event vendor for Q3 product launch

All —

Quick legal check completed. Two small edits requested on the Brightline SOW: clarify data handling for embargoed press materials and limit on liability to the amount paid under the SOW. On EventCraft quote, request a simple cancellation clause (30 days notice, deposit refundable pro-rata). I attached a short comparison doc with redline recommendations: SOW_comparison_notes.docx

If vendors can accept edits, Finance can issue POs for the base packages and we can sign the SOWs via DocuSign. Sarah / EventCraft — if you accept the edits, please re-upload or confirm and we’ll send the PO.

Thanks,
Markus Klein
Senior Counsel
Redwood Inference

Attachment: SOW_comparison_notes.docx
